title: Gibbs sampling as named full-conditional MCMC
dek: Wikipedia Gibbs: sample each coordinate from its conditional. A special MH with acceptance 1. Still needs diagnostics.
story: Gibbs sampling on Wikipedia updates one parameter (or block) at a time from its full conditional given the rest. When those conditionals are conjugate, it is easy to code and easy to trust too much.
It is Metropolis–Hastings with a perfect proposal, so you always accept. Slow mixing when parameters are highly correlated is the remaining sin (banana posteriors, uncentered hierarchies).
stats-conjugacy and stats-mcmc are the hand-offs. Eight schools is the hierarchical celebrity.
deep: Reparameterise hierarchical variances (non-centered) when Gibbs mixes like glue.
Blocked Gibbs updates a vector together when coordinates fight.
Data augmentation Gibbs (probit) is a trick, not a new likelihood.
Do not skip R̂ because 'it's Gibbs'.

visual.caption: Coordinate-wise conditionals stacked. Correlation across layers is why mixing can still fail.
